mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,config_id,current_version,status,revision,classification,execution_mode FROM configuration_head h WHERE config_id=#{configId} AND kind='MODEL' AND execution_mode=#{mode} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.project_id,m.config_id,m.model_config_revision,d.content_json,m.content_sha256, r.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,m.status,m.schema_version,m.schema_manifest_sha256,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification,m.execution_mode, CASE WHEN m.execution_mode='SIMULATION' THEN JSON_OBJECT('definition',m.simulation_definition, 'provider',m.provider,'region',m.region,'model_id',m.model_id,'model_version',m.model_version,'limits',m.limits, 'request_parameter_schema_ref',m.request_parameter_schema_ref,'model_protocol_revision',m.model_protocol_revision) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('provider',m.provider,'base_url',m.base_url,'region',m.region,'model_id',m.model_id,'model_version',m.model_version, 'auth_ref',m.auth_ref,'credential_reference_id',m.credential_reference_id,'credential_revision',m.credential_revision, 'limits',m.limits,'price_version',m.price_version,'currency',m.currency,'data_policy',m.data_policy, 'request_parameter_schema_ref',m.request_parameter_schema_ref,'model_protocol_revision',m.model_protocol_revision) END AS projection FROM model_config_revision m JOIN model_configuration_definition d ON d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.model_config_revision=m.model_config_revision AND d.content_sha256=m.content_sha256 AND d.schema_version=m.schema_version AND d.schema_manifest_sha256=m.schema_manifest_sha256 AND d.created_by=m.created_by AND d.created_at=m.created_at AND d.classification=m.classification JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.version_id=m.model_config_revision AND r.entity_kind='MODEL_CONFIG' AND r.owner_project_id <=> m.project_id WHERE m.model_config_revision=#{versionId} AND m.configuration_kind='MODEL' AND m.execution_mode=#{mode} AND m.revision=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{versionId} AND relation_kind='MODEL_CONFIGURATION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id
mapper.update: UPDATE configuration_head SET current_version=#{versionId} WHERE config_id=#{configId} AND kind='MODEL' AND execution_mode=#{mode} AND current_version IS NULL AND status='DRAFT' AND revision=1

UPDATE configuration_head SET current_version=#{versionId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE config_id=#{configId} AND kind='MODEL' AND execution_mode=#{mode} AND status='DRAFT' AND current_version=#{oldVersion} AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='CP-08' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch} AND auth_epoch=#{authEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{configId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='model.configuration_saved'
